payload.title: The post-implementation Gate B review runs against cycle:<id> with an empty artifact hash, so its verdict is about the plan and not the delivered PR, yet it decides whether the nightly auto-merge evaluation over open ARIA PRs runs
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_orchestrator.py:2883-2905 (review_runner is called with impl_artifacts_ref defaulting to cycle:<id> and worker_artifact_hash defaulting to empty)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_orchestrator.py:2929-2937 (a no_gaps verdict is what lets auto_merge_runner run)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/review_runner.py:281-287 (the artifact-hash check runs only when both ref and hash are present)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle_phases/implementer.py:367-370 (K6: the implementation is minted for the executor and delivered after the cycle; the diff and the PR are reviewed on the PR itself)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/auto_merge_runners.py:151-172 (the nightly runner is constructed with executes_merges False and only evaluates)
payload.rule_violated: A gate named 'post-implementation review' (autonomy_orchestrator.py:2863-2874) must review the implementation; a verdict about an artifact that does not exist yet cannot guard anything that exists.
payload.notes: In a converging cycle the worker lane has produced nothing, so review_runner is asked to judge 'cycle:<id>' with no hash: the artifact check is skipped and the judges re-review the plan, at up to 1800 s per judge and max_iterations_per_phase rounds. The implementation is minted for the executor only after this point, so the verdict is about no PR; it nevertheless gates whether the nightly evaluates the open ARIA PRs, and a reader of the cycle summary sees a post-implementation review that reviewed nothing. Close condition: Either bind Gate B to the delivered artifact (mint it from the executor's recorded PR head sha) or remove it from the converged-cycle path so the auto-merge evaluation is not gated by a verdict about the cycle. Test: with an empty worker_result review_runner is not invoked with impl_artifacts_ref 'cycle:<id>' and the evaluation is not skipped by a review verdict (red today). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
